caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass vessel with a rounded body, a tall, narrow neck, and a flared rim. The vessel is rendered in shades of light green, with darker green accents along the edges and base, suggesting the thickness of the glass. The glass has two short, cylindrical spouts projecting from opposite sides of the body, each curving slightly upward. The base of the vessel is wide, circular, and flat, supporting the rounded body. Reflections and highlights are visible on the vessel’s surface, enhancing the appearance of transparency and translucency. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color with no additional objects or decorations present. The artist’s signature is visible near the bottom edge of the image.
title: Green Vase
